Audio uses the Fermata media service. App visibility on Android Auto depends on the phone, installation method and head unit. A redesigned interface cannot guarantee video or visibility in Android Auto.

Phone and TV media playback work independently from car projection. Video in a vehicle is for parked use.

Zair Auto · Audio is the Android Auto audio browser: its screen is drawn by Android Auto and does not show YouTube or this carousel. The full Fermata projection interface has the carousel and YouTube when its module is enabled, but access depends on your Android Auto installation. Renaming the app or redesigning it does not unlock projection. Video in a vehicle is for parked use.
